title: Member
description: A person inside a tenant. Server-written: role and standing decide who may waive a step, so a client that could write this could grant itself the standing. Membership needs no invite flow — the first person from a Workspace domain creates the tenant and everyone after joins by being from that domain.

schema_version.description: 1. Absent reads as 1. See specs/2026-08-20-firestore-design.md section 9.1.

uid.description: Firebase uid. Equal to the token sub.

photo_url.description: Google's own URL. Rotates when the user changes their photo and can 404, so it is never the only copy.

photo_ref.description: Our copy in Cloud Storage, taken at first sign-in. This is what a sealed record points at, because a record must still render years later.

role.description: The first member of a tenant is owner. Everyone after is technician. Promotion is an owner-only server action.

standing.description: What this person may do that a technician may not. StepOutcome.waived_by requires a named person with standing, and standing a person can grant themselves is not standing.

may_waive_to_strictness.description: May waive a step required at or below this strictness. -1 waives nothing.

may_approve_orders.description: May approve a drafted purchase order. A PO is drafted, never sent.

disabled.description: When an employer disables an account, access ends the same instant — session verification re-checks revocation on every request.

calendar.description: That the account is linked. NEVER the refresh token, which lives in /user_secrets and is unreachable by any client.
